query: Consider FNHA's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document allow verbally conveyed information to be considered as Confidential Information?
gold: 1. Definition. "Confidential Information" means any information identified as confidential by the FNHA that is part of the FNHA’s request for proposal number 2019RFP-02, Architectural & Design Team Consultants for Metro Vancouver Office Project (“RFP”) whether in oral, written electronic or any other form or medium whatsoever, including but not limited to Appendix B of the RFP, questions answered or information disclosed by FNHA related to confidential aspects of the RFP or discussions held related to the RFP.
rag_answer:
Yes. FNHA’s Non-Disclosure Agreement expressly covers orally conveyed information.

Under Section 1, “Confidential Information” includes any information identified as confidential by FNHA that is part of RFP 2019RFP-02, “whether in oral, written, electronic or any other form or medium whatsoever,” and also includes questions answered or information disclosed by FNHA related to confidential aspects of the RFP or discussions held related to the RFP.

Therefore, verbally conveyed information can be considered Confidential Information if FNHA identifies it as confidential and it relates to the RFP.

judge.gold_summary: 金标定义中“Confidential Information”包括由FNHA标识为机密且属于RFP 2019RFP-02的信息，形式可为oral、written、electronic或其他任何形式，因此口头传达的信息可构成机密信息。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答指出FNHA NDA明确涵盖口头传达信息，并引用定义中“whether in oral, written, electronic or any other form or medium whatsoever”，同时说明需由FNHA标识为机密且与RFP相关。
judge.reason: 系统回答准确覆盖了金标关键要点：机密信息包括口头形式，且强调需由FNHA标识为机密并与RFP相关，与金标一致。
